narrationTexts: Good, confirms the migration pattern. Now editing the 11 in-repo files (excluding the vendored adapter).
Verifying no `db.query` calls remain outside the vendored file.
finalText:
**Migration done.** Moved 10 files, 30 call sites, from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

One file still uses `db.query`: [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says it's a vendored copy, replaced wholesale on upgrade, do not edit locally.

Next: update legacy-orm upstream, or confirm you want it patched anyway.
